text.tspan: Input regions/contig are partitioned into N super regions; each thread has its own reader/writer. Unlike markdup, each thread may handle multiple super regions.
Reads are clustered based on alignment start and
end position (within wiggle room). If UMI clustering
is enabled, positional clustering is used to refine
When enabled, forward and reverse reads are forced
Reads with no alignment are not clustered; each becomes its own singleton and is passed through to
output as a singleton consensus read.
Reads with matching UMIs are clustered together
Insertions are realigned. An MSA matrix is built with the
insertions as anchor points. Left and right softclip
consensus matrices are generated separately using MSA.
Use majority voting to determine the consensus base at each
position. Majority ratio is used to calculate a consensus quality
